name: result-podcast

rules.editorial: Chọn câu trọn ý, mở đầu có hook thật trong lời nói; bỏ lần nói hỏng, lặp và khoảng ngừng. Không bịa câu, số liệu, nguồn hoặc lời kêu gọi. Đồng bộ mọi điểm nhấn với timestamp từ được nói.
rules.visual:
# RESULT as a system Same method as recipes/clean-os/SYSTEM.md section 5: invariants and the house look make it RESULT, slots follow the content, catalog.json records what each reel used. ## Thesis **The story told across a table of real, tactile objects.** Warm film, paper, handwriting: the idea becomes an object you could hold (a note, a ticket, a receipt, a clipping), the voice keeps going over it. ## Invariants 1. The speaker's footage as shot: no warm grade or sepia on the face unless the user asks for it (`look.asked`). Grain + per-frame-seeded dust canvas, vignette. The warmth lives in the paper, kraft and polaroid surfaces. 2. Captions: one or two words, Inter Tight; two-tier emphasis (small line + one big bold word); key words in Caveat. 3. Film-burn light leaks at section turns (screen-blended radial gradients sweeping in). 4. Artifacts sit on a surface (navy card, kraft paper, cork, wood) and move like paper: slide in with rotation, settle, get stamped/written on. Handwriting is drawn in with a clip-path wipe; marker circles with stroke-dashoffset. 5. At most three punch-ins per reel; no zoom on every cut. ## House look (fixed) One house look per style, small variation per reel: `house.json` in this folder holds it, and the build reads it instead of inventing a new look each reel. The house look is only the type, the captions, the accents, the insert framing and the speaker's face as shot. The COMPONENTS that fill the slots are NEW every reel, so reels don't look alike: phone-UI scenes, paper props, polaroid / card / collage treatments, transitions, hook devices and outro devices. `scripts/components.py plan --style result-podcast` lists what the last 7 reels used (avoid) and what is free; `broll_qa.py --style result-podcast` warns on a repeat (check `components`). Grade: none on the speaker's face: the plate keeps its as-shot colour and every insert is conformed to it (`insert_prep.py --ref `); the house look is the type, graphics and devices above. B-roll obeys the people rules (`people-rules.json`) and shows its line (references/broll.md section 0). A new look element (a new transition, a new device) only enters the house when the user asks for it, and then it replaces the old one in house.json. House: the speaker's face as shot (a warm film look, `look.film`, only when the user asks for it), the two-tier Inter Tight captions with Caveat key words, navy and kraft surfaces, polaroids and paper as the insert frame, grain and dust. Not house (new every reel, see catalog.json): the paper props and artifacts, the polaroid / collage treatments, the transitions (the film-burn leaks were the first set), the hook and the outro devices. ## Face RESULT (the talking-head mode; faceresult.py) - The speaker's face stays on screen (>= 65 %); props sit beside, above or below it in zones measured from face.json, never on it (the build checks every prop, caption and punch-in against the face core); full-screen cards <= 2.5 s. - Captions: the two-tier caption on the navy card (small line 62 px, big word 132 px, Caveat key word 150 px). - No film-burn leak over the face (an orange sweep across the face is a colour change): transitions are components. - The plate is held for the tail (0.45 s) and keyframed every second; nothing ever filters it. ## Slots (content: what the story needs) - **Artifacts** (one per story beat, from the story's world; NEW every reel: not in the last 7 RESULT reels, see `components.py plan --style result-podcast`): polaroid, paper stack, notebook to-do, sticky notes on cork, boarding pass + stamp, thermal receipt, envelopes + postmarks, newspaper clipping, tear-off calendar, business card, ticket stub, map, Post-it on a laptop, index cards, cassette label, receipt from a shop, etc. - **Surface palette**: the house pair navy + kraft (cork / wood / linen only when the story is set there). - **Comic props** (only for funny beats): REC frame, declined call, cursor dialog, chat bubble, emoji sticker. - **Music**: a warm bed (lo-fi, piano); rotate. ## Generator For each sentence: what object would a person in that story physically hold at that moment? Make the spoken claim appear on that object as it is said (written, printed, stamped, circled). Prefer objects from the speaker's own world. ## Planning procedure 1. `components.py plan --style result-podcast`: what the last 7 reels used (avoid) and what is free. 2. Per sentence: the object from the story's world (Generator above); pick props, polaroid / collage treatments, transitions, the hook and the outro device that the last 7 reels did not use; register new ones with `components.py add` (with a sig). 3. Build, `components.py check --style result-podcast --project $P` (broll_qa.py warns too), render; after the user's yes `components.py record --style result-podcast --project $P --reel `. # RESULT: a warm podcast-style edit with paper, film and handwriting Call it with: **"edit this in RESULT style"**, **"loompixual style"**. The look comes from @loompixual's "RESULT" edit. Libraries and licences behind it: STYLE-LIBRARIES.md in this folder. **When to use:** storytelling or nostalgic talking heads, podcast-style monologues, lists of memories or examples where a photo per idea helps. Warmer and more tactile than Clean OS. **Two ways to build it:** - **Face RESULT** (the default for a talking head): the speaker's face stays on screen as shot and the paper props sit beside, above or below it, never on it. Section "Face RESULT" below; `faceresult.py`. - **Paper-led RESULT**: full-screen paper scenes between lines (`example/` in the private edition). On a talking head it breaks the budgets (face >= 65 %, a full-screen card <= 2.5 s): use it only for a narrated or footage-free reel. ## The grammar 1. **Captions:** one or two words at a time, centred, Inter Tight. Two-tier emphasis: a small line, then one big bold word. Key words in Caveat handwriting. 2. **Cards:** navy text cards with film dust; polaroid photo cards; a paper stack whose pictures swap stop-motion; framed B-roll. 3. **Texture:** dust and grain drawn on a canvas seeded per frame (deterministic in render); film-burn light leaks at section turns. 4. **Props for the funny beats:** comic emoji stickers, a REC frame, an incoming-call card with a finger tapping "decline", a cursor clicking a dialog, a chat-bubble card. 5. **Cuts:** hide jump cuts with a 0.2 s picture morph-dissolve between lines while the audio hard-cuts. No zoom on every cut: at most three comic punch-ins per reel (per-cut zooms were rejected as annoying). ## Pipeline ```bash S=~/.claude/skills/ghost-editor; P=~/reels/ # 1. attempt log: Gemini 2.5 Pro over the WHOLE raw take (every attempt, restart and filler, verbatim) # 2. takes: best take per line, cut only pauses > 0.7 s inside a line, start each line at the voice onset (RMS > -30 dB, no breaths) cp $S/recipes/result-podcast/example/{takes.py,build.py,gen_broll.sh} $P/ && cd $P && python3 takes.py # -> build/takes.json + build/rough.mp4 # 3. the rough cut: transcribe it (build/rough.words.json), audit it verbatim with Gemini 2.5 Pro; fix and re-audit until clean python3 $S/scripts/transcribe.py build/rough.mp4 --out build/rough.words.json --lang # 4. B-roll stills / photos for the polaroids and stack (gen_broll.sh: AI stills with $S/scripts/broll_gen.py), the fonts, # then adapt build.py's beats to the new script (every beat is keyed to the spoken words) bash gen_broll.sh && python3 $S/recipes/clean-os/fetch_fonts.py $P "Inter Tight:ital,wght@0,400..800;1,400..800" "Caveat:wght@400..700" python3 build.py && $S/scripts/hf.sh lint && $S/scripts/hf.sh snapshot --at $S/scripts/hf.sh render -o renders/.mp4 ``` ## Checks that caught real problems - Whisper merges restarts ("millennials alw- millennials") into a clean sentence and can even invent a script word that was never said. The take picker left 6 restarts in until two Gemini 2.5 Pro audits found them all. - Hide each caption with an explicit `fromTo` placed AFTER its fade-in; a bare `set` inside the fade gets overridden and the caption stays on screen. - Seed the per-frame dust/grain canvas by frame number, never by wall-clock time, or renders won't match previews. ## Worked example `example/` holds an English storytelling reel, "keep the paper" (12 lines, about 32 s of speech + a 2.2 s outro), with `script.txt`: on every trip the speaker keeps one paper thing a day. `takes.py` picks the best take of each line (two of them follow a false start) and writes the rough cut; `build.py` lays the takes with the morph dissolve and keys every beat to the rough cut's words: a train ticket stamped "day 1" on kraft, a thermal receipt that prints out of its slot and gets its missing address circled, a notebook page closing over a pressed leaf, a photo-count notification and a storage dialog a cursor dismisses over the speaker (with the only two punch-ins and two emoji stickers), a paper stack whose pictures swap stop-motion, a polaroid with the ticket landing on it and handwriting on both, a sticky note, the final navy card held through the outro; film-burn leaks at the three turns only, `chillax` as the bed. `gen_broll.sh` makes its six stills (no people in any of them). It is for reading and copying: the recording is yours to supply. Re-time `LINES` in takes.py from your own attempt log, transcribe the rough cut with `--lang en`, and fix any word key the build stops on (keys accept spellings like `"thousand|3000"`). A dry run (a test-pattern recording with a synthetic voice and two false starts, the six stills from gen_broll.sh) builds and lints with 0 errors; it has not been rendered with real footage. ## Face RESULT (talking head: props beside the face, never on it) Call it with: **"Face RESULT"**, **"RESULT on my face"**, or **"RESULT style"** on a talking head. `faceresult.py`, on the shared base `scripts/lib/facereel.py`. It shares this folder's house.json and catalog.json, so a new reel cannot repeat a RESULT prop by accident. **House (never changes):** - the speaker's plate AS SHOT: no grade, no filter, no vignette on the face; a slow 4 % drift; at most 3 punch-ins (they pivot on the mouth line so the chin barely moves); film grain + per-frame dust over everything (texture only); - two-tier captions on a navy card under the chin: a small Inter Tight line (62 px) over one big word (132 px) or a Caveat key word (150 px), sized to fit; one text layer at a time (a chest prop or a card that carries the words drops them); - paper objects from the line's world BESIDE (left / right column), ABOVE (top band) or BELOW (chest band) the face, placed in zones measured from build/face.json per prop window, inside the Instagram safe area (top 220, bottom 1500); - full-screen cards (navy / kraft / cork / paper) <= 2.5 s, pushing in slowly; the face on screen >= 65 %; <= 3 stock / AI inserts a minute, each in a polaroid or paper frame, prepared by insert_prep.py. **New every reel** (`components.py plan --style result-podcast`): the props, the card treatments, the entrances (`enter=`: none / slap / toss / unfold / swing / fade / side / drop / rise), the full-screen card entrances (fade / iris / push / wipe), the hook and the outro. ```bash S=; P= # $P/assets/plate.mp4 (the approved raw cut, video only, as shot), $P/assets/voice.wav, $P/build/words.json (edit seconds) python3 $S/scripts/face_track.py $P/assets/plate.mp4 --out $P/build/face.json python3 $S/scripts/components.py plan --style result-podcast # avoid the recent reels' components # write $P/reel.py (below): this reel's beats, keyed to words; example-face/reel.py is a whole one to start from # (copied into $P, point its sys.path line at $S/recipes/result-podcast) python3 $P/reel.py $P # -> index.html + build/{plan,beats,sfx_events}.json; FAILS on a broken rule (below) $S/scripts/hf.sh lint ; python3 $S/recipes/seoul-list/snap.py beats $P # look at every beat's strip python3 $S/scripts/finals.py preview $P --out $P/finals --style "Face RESULT" --code R01 --title "..." # WAIT for the user's OK python3 $S/scripts/components.py add --style result-podcast --id --kind prop --sig 'class="prop fr-"' --desc "..." python3 $S/scripts/components.py record --style result-podcast --project $P --reel R01 # after the user's yes ``` ```python import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/recipes/result-podcast") from faceresult import * R = FaceResult(sys.argv[1], cover=[(23.5, 24.2)], music={"id": "chillax", "db": -21}) t = R.t # word refs: "word", "word#2", "^word" (its end), "word+0.1", "two words", a number a, b = t("beach") - 0.1, t("^work") + 0.4 R.prop("card", a, b, "right", '
tasks
', w=260, h=380, what="a note", enter="slap", cls="fr-note") R.write("#card .l1", t("tasks")) # handwriting on its word; also R.stamp, R.pop, R.draw, R.words_in, R.show / R.hide R.scene("big", t("even"), t("even") + 2.0, "kraft", "
...
", what="a full-screen card", enter="iris", caps=True) R.punch(t("better")) R.build(BIG={"work", "better"}, SCRIPT={"breather"}, css=".l1 { position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 40px; font-size: 52px; }") ``` - `R.prop(id, a, b, zone, html, w, h, what, dx=0, dy=0, rot=0, enter=..., leave="fade", nocap=None, cls="fr-")`: `zone` = `left` / `right` / `top` / `chest`; it fails when it does not fit the zone or touches the face; `cls` is the catalog sig (`class="prop fr-"`). - `R.scene(id, a, b, "navy"|"kraft"|"cork"|"paperbg", html, what, caps=False, enter="fade"|"iris"|"push"|"wipe", cls=...)` - `R.polaroid(...)`, `R.still(...)` / `R.video(...)` (an insert: counted, picked up by broll_vision picks from index.html) - `R.build(BIG={...}, SCRIPT={...}, css="...")`: captions, plate, grain, dust, audio; prints the numbers and `components.py check`. **The build refuses** (fix the generator): a prop that touches the face (also under a punch-in or the drift) or does not fit its zone; a caption card the chin reaches; a full-screen card > 2.5 s; a look-away (`cover` / build/cover_windows.json) not hidden while a card is fully in; the face on screen < 65 %; > 3 inserts a minute; a 4th punch-in; an id named c (caption ids). **Worked example:** `example-face/` holds an English talking head, "the doorway effect" (11 sentences, about 42 s), with `script.txt`: you walk into a room and forget why, because a doorway tells the brain the scene is over. `reel.py` keys every beat to the words: a paper door already beside the speaker on frame 1 that opens on an empty doorway, a paper fridge whose magnet letters spell WHY, a ticket ("memory: fine ✓", THE DOOR stamped) with the first punch-in, a label tape printing DOORWAY EFFECT on the chest, a film slate that claps on "film" and changes scene on "doorway", the one full-screen card (2.44 s, wiped in: an index card drops into an OLD SCENES drawer) over the look-away, a graph-paper card in the top band whose bars grow on "door" and "room", a paper megaphone on the chest with the second punch-in, and the door again as the outro (it shuts on "close", a wedge props it open on "don't"). Every prop is drawn (0 inserts), 15 sounds from the kit, `lo-fi-02` as the bed. It is for reading and copying: the recording is yours to supply. Transcribe your cut with `--lang en`, take its look-aways from `scripts/cover_windows.py` (leave `cover=` out to read build/cover_windows.json), and fix any word key the build stops on (`fixes=` maps a misheard word to the spoken one). A dry run (a synthetic voice, a stand-in talking-head plate tracked by face_track.py) builds with the face on screen 94.3 %, one full-screen card covering the look-away and 2 punch-ins, lints with 0 errors and was checked beat by beat with snap.py; it has not been rendered.
rules.motion: Theo house/SYSTEM của recipe; mọi chuyển động seek-safe, nhấn đúng lời nói, không lặp hiệu ứng ở mọi câu.
rules.sound: Giọng là chính; SFX nhỏ theo vai trò, không đặt mỗi từ một tiếng. Nhạc nhẹ, duck dưới giọng. Không tự suy đoán âm thanh của video mẫu từ ảnh tĩnh.
rules.assets: Chỉ dùng ảnh/footage thực sự liên quan câu đang nói; lưu nguồn. Thiếu ảnh phù hợp thì bỏ điểm chèn, không thay bằng ảnh sai ý. Dữ liệu biểu đồ phải có trong lời nói hoặc nguồn được cung cấp. Không tái sử dụng nội dung ví dụ của recipe.

checks: Chữ tiếng Việt đầy đủ dấu, đọc được trên điện thoại
Không che khuôn mặt; giữ màu da như video nguồn
Nội dung và thời điểm chữ đúng lời nói
Không cắt hụt lời; hình và âm thanh khớp
Không có khung đen hoặc đứng hình ngoài chủ ý
Tuân thủ bố cục, nhịp và đặc trưng của recipe
Giọng rõ, SFX và nhạc không lấn giọng
